title: Ivo and the Kitchen
author: Bram Nystrom
blurb: Wendell Winterbourne, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
